## 1. Executive Summary & Value Proposition
Anil Sharma is an accomplished industrial engineering leader with over 28 years of multi-sectoral expertise across continuous process industries, petrochemical complexes, and heavy manufacturing. He currently oversees plant reliability, electrical infrastructure, automation, and asset integrity for over 15 world-scale petrochemical facilities and associated township infrastructures at the Reliance Industries Limited Bharuch Complex.

Beyond physical plant management, he is the creator of several global engineering platforms, including **LiveSimulators.com**, **DesignCalculators.co.in**, **ReliabilityTools.co.in**, and **ElectroSafe.homes**—providing free, ad-free, high-precision tools and real-time physics simulators to engineers worldwide.

### Key Value Pillars
- **Zero-Breakdown Mindset**: Transforming maintenance from an emergency cost center into a strategic profit driver and asset-availability multiplier.
- **Large-Scale Petrochemical Capital Projects**: Steering capital project governance, switchyard modernizations, and asset reliability across world-scale continuous process units.
- **Plant-Wide Power Distribution Automation (220kV to 6.6kV)**: Successfully engineered and commissioned automated electrical distribution and load shedding systems, securing system stability and eliminating cascading blackout events.
- **LiveSimulators Ecosystem**: Built 65+ interactive virtual engineering laboratories solving complex first-principles physics directly in the browser with float64 precision.
- **Workforce Facilitation**: SHRM Certified Facilitator, DVN Certified IMS Auditor, and Technical Capability Lead who has trained over 200 engineers, mentored 40+ into leadership, and conducted 80+ specialized technical workshops.

## 2. Professional Chronology & Measurable Achievements

### Reliance Industries Limited, Continuous Petrochemical Operations (Feb 2008 – Present)
**Position**: Senior Engineering Leader – Central Engineering Services | Electrical, Power Electronics, Automation & Capital Projects
- **Project Scope**: Steering multidisciplinary capital project engineering and asset integrity across continuous process petrochemical facilities.
- **Commissioning Leadership**: Led electrical and instrumentation commissioning for world-scale continuous process units including PTA, PET, GCU (Gas Cracking Unit), and complex utility plants.
- **Substation & Load Shedding Automation**: Engineered and deployed integrated PLC-based electrical distribution and automated load shedding schemes, preventing blackout cascades and securing high-voltage power stability.
- **Inventory & Cost Reduction**: Optimized spares inventory through equipment criticality matrices (FMEA) and standardized SAP-PM categorization.
- **Technical Capability Building**: Designed and conducted 80+ specialized technical workshops on E&I reliability, power electronics, and electrical safety.
- **Executive Accolades**: Won 5 Safety Champion Awards, 4 Top Trainer Awards, and 2 Leadership in Reliability Innovation Awards.

### Reliance Industries Limited – Petroleum Retail, Punjab & Rajasthan (Feb 2004 – Jan 2008)
**Position**: Commissioning & Reliability Lead (Engineering Incharge)
- **Multi-Site Project Execution**: Directed end-to-end greenfield engineering commissioning for a multi-state network of automated retail outlets across Punjab and Rajasthan.
- **Cross-Disciplinary Command**: Provided unified engineering leadership across Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, and IT networks.
- **Hazardous Area Safety**: Designed and delivered specialized hazardous area safety and explosive-atmosphere training to over 350 technicians with zero reported safety incidents.
- **Talent Development**: Led technical RCA and electrical systems training modules across regional operating centers.

### Ambuja Cements Limited, Punjab & Himachal Pradesh (Jul 1995 – Feb 2004)
**Position**: Engineer – Electrical & Instrumentation
- **Greenfield Commissioning**: Key electrical and instrumentation team member during the erection, commissioning, and stabilization of a 2.5 MTPA greenfield cement plant in Punjab and Himachal Pradesh.
- **Energy Optimization**: Spearheaded plant-wide electrical automation and energy conservation initiatives, lowering plant energy consumption by 2.5%.
- **Grid Power Quality**: Automated substation operations and capacitor bank switching, significantly improving power factor and eliminating downtime.

## 3. Interactive Virtual Engineering Laboratories (LiveSimulators.com)

### 1. Power Electronics Virtual Lab
- **URL**: https://livesimulators.com/lab/power-electronics-lab
- **Scope**: First-principles browser simulation of switching converter topologies (Buck, Boost, Buck-Boost), SPWM inverter synthesis, Foster thermal networks, and dynamic SiC/IGBT switching loss.
- **Key Formulation**: $V_{out} = \frac{V_{in}}{1 - D} \cdot \eta = \frac{P_{out}}{P_{out} + P_{sw} + P_{cond}}$
- **Standards**: IEC 61800, IEEE 519, JEDEC JESD51.

### 2. Power Systems & Substation Grid Lab
- **URL**: https://livesimulators.com/lab/power-systems-lab
- **Scope**: Dynamic grid modeling reflecting 27 automated industrial substations. Interactive 3-phase symmetrical fault analysis, transformer OC/SC parameter extraction, and frequency-based load shedding.
- **Key Formulation**: $I_{sc} = \frac{V_{LL}}{\sqrt{3} \cdot Z_{th}} \cdot \Delta f = \frac{P_{gen} - P_{load}}{2H \cdot f_0}$
- **Standards**: IEEE 399 (Brown Book), IEC 60909, IEEE 242.

### 3. SafeOps Industrial UPS Simulator
- **URL**: https://livesimulators.com/lab/safeops-ups
- **Scope**: Industrial zero-downtime power simulator. Models dual-bus UPS redundancy (2N/2N+1), static bypass synchronization windows, inverter SCR commutation, and Peukert battery autonomy curves.
- **Key Formulation**: $t = H \cdot \left(\frac{C}{I \cdot H}\right)^k \cdot \text{THD}_v < 3\%$
- **Standards**: IEC 62040-3, IEEE 485, IEEE 1184.

### 4. ElectroLive Electrical Safety & Arc Flash Lab
- **URL**: https://livesimulators.com/lab/electrolive-electrical-safety
- **Scope**: Interactive occupational safety simulator for industrial switchgear. Computes incident energy in cal/cm², defines boundary clearance zones, models earth grid step/touch voltages, and selects PPE categories.
- **Key Formulation**: $E_i = 4.184 \cdot C_f \cdot E_n \cdot \left(\frac{t}{0.2}\right) \cdot \left(\frac{610^x}{D^x}\right)\text{ cal/cm}^2$
- **Standards**: IEEE 1584-2018, NFPA 70E, IEEE 80.

### 5. Turbomachinery & Rotor Dynamics Suite
- **URL**: https://mech.livesimulators.com/
- **Scope**: Rotating equipment dynamics platform. Models Jeffcott rotor whirling, hydrodynamic bearing stiffness/damping coefficients, Campbell frequency diagrams, and dual-plane dynamic field balancing.
- **Key Formulation**: $M \ddot{q} + (C + \Omega G) \dot{q} + K q = F_{\text{unbalance}}(\Omega)$
- **Standards**: API 612 / 617, ISO 10816 / 20816, API 684.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (Structured Knowledge Base)

### Q: Who is Anil Sharma and what is his background in industrial reliability?
**A**: Anil Sharma is an industrial engineering leader with over 28 years of continuous process experience across petrochemical and heavy manufacturing complexes. He specializes in plant reliability (RCM/FMEA), electrical power distribution, and engineering capability building, alongside creating free open-access engineering tools for students and practitioners worldwide.

### Q: What is the 'Zero-Breakdown Mindset' in reliability engineering?
**A**: It is a strategic philosophy where maintenance is treated as an investment in operational uptime rather than an operational cost center. By deploying RCM, FMEA, and RCA, plant teams transition from reactive firefighting to predictive asset integrity, targeting 100% operational reliability.

### Q: Where can engineers access Anil Sharma's free reliability engineering tools and virtual simulators?
**A**: As part of his technical philanthropy mission to democratize engineering knowledge, Anil Sharma created LiveSimulators.com (65+ interactive virtual labs), ReliabilityTools.co.in (Weibull & MTBF modeling), DesignCalculators.co.in (150+ calculators across IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards), and ElectroSafe.homes—all completely free and ad-free.

### Q: What industries and systems does Anil Sharma specialize in?
**A**: With 28+ years of hands-on industrial leadership, Anil Sharma specializes in continuous process manufacturing, petrochemicals, and power systems, with deep expertise in electrical distribution, automated load shedding architectures, and asset lifecycle governance.

### Q: What training, mentorship, and certification programs does Anil Sharma offer?
**A**: As a SHRM Certified Facilitator, DVN IMS Lead Auditor, and Top Trainer at RIL Learning Academy, Anil Sharma has trained and mentored over 200 engineers in RCM, FMEA, electrical safety compliance, and leadership development, having conducted 80+ structured technical workshops.
